先响应，再理解 · Beamhop 交互随笔 03: Respond, then understand · Beamhop interactive essay 03
一个无需模型的小浮层：提示词直接输入，本地检索与推荐，相关经验按需展开。: A small panel without model dependencies: type a prompt, find local matches and inspect related experience when needed.
一个顺手的工具，不能让你站在门口等它想明白。: A useful tool should not make you wait at the door while it figures things out.
选中一段话，唤起 Beamhop。材料已经在手里，去处看得见，想交代什么，直接写: Select a passage and invoke Beamhop. The material is ready, the destination is visible, and you can type what you want done. Any additional connections can come later.
试一试 · 所有资料与连接均为模拟: Try it · All material and connections are simulated
业务数据不能离开公司内网。: Business data must stay on the company network.
希望怎么处理这段材料？: What should happen with this material?
把本地索引切到“后台更新中”，同时输入提示词。你仍然可以选择去处、暂存或填入。晚: Set the local index to “Updating in background” and type a prompt. You can still choose a destination, hold material or prepare it. Late results only add an entry point. No model is called; the delay demonstrates behavior and is not a native performance test.
把空间还给正在做的事。: Leave room for the work at hand.
上一版把来源、工作说明、关联理由、参考、输入和动作都摊在面前。每一块都有理由，放: The previous version exposed the source, work description, relation, reference, input and actions at once. Each had a reason to exist, but together they felt like a form. The lesson from Spotlight and Raycast is a density that makes input and action immediately recognizable.
首屏只留下来源摘要、提示词和去处。原文与关联依据点开再看；跨项目经验只占一个小入: The initial view keeps a source excerpt, prompt and destination. Open the original and matching evidence when needed; cross-project experience gets one small entry point. Prompts can grow to multiple lines, and long work names remain available in full in the selector. Compactness should not depend on cutting off content.
真正的 Mac 实现继续使用系统面板、文本输入、菜单和标准按钮。采用新系统外观时: The actual Mac implementation should keep system panels, text input, menus and standard buttons. Adopt new appearances through system controls and materials, while preserving readability on older systems and with reduced transparency or increased contrast. This web preview cannot replace validation in a real NSPanel.
经验来自记录，不需要模型供应商。: Experience comes from records, not a model provider.
“项目 B 的部署经验”应该来自你允许 Beamhop 使用的记录，保留出处、时: “Project B’s deployment experience” should come from records you allow Beamhop to use, with their source, date and conditions preserved. Finding that record does not require a model-generated answer or an API key from the user.
第一版拟用一套本地推荐流程：全文检索找内容，客户名、项目标识和文档引用找关系，再: The proposed first version uses a local recommendation process: full-text search for content; client names, project identifiers and document references for relations; then ranking informed by confirmed destinations and recent use. An explicit choice takes precedence. When there is no reliable match, offer recent destinations without inventing a connection.
例如，客户邮件可通过客户标识关联 A 的部署方案；方案里已有的“内网部署”条目与: For example, a client identifier can link an email to A’s deployment plan. A cross-project reference can appear when the plan’s existing “on-premises deployment” entry matches B’s pilot record, or when both cite the same deployment specification. Show this evidence as the reason; no model needs to write an explanation. These are proposed rules. This page uses fixed examples and does not implement a general recommendation engine.
推荐可以小，依据要清楚。: Keep recommendations small and evidence clear.
用本地倒排索引和全文检索找候选。中文要处理分词或字词片段匹配；对人名、客户名、路: Use a local inverted index and full-text search to retrieve candidates. Chinese requires tokenization or character and word fragment matching. Keep exact matches for people, clients, paths and document identifiers.
沿文档引用、明确关联和共同来源找相邻记录。只走有限的关系，避免因为“都在同一个大: Find neighboring records through citations, explicit links and shared sources. Bound that traversal so that being in the same large project does not recommend everything. Deduplicate repeated content.
区分同一客户、同一约束、共同引用和只是最近打开过。先用可解释的规则或排序融合；将: Distinguish a shared client, shared constraint or citation from mere recent use. Start with explainable rules or rank fusion. Use explicit corrections within their relevant scope, rather than turning one choice into a permanent preference.
这可以用普通索引、图的邻接表和小型排序程序完成，不需要生成模型，也不必先上向量模: Ordinary indexes, adjacency lists and a small ranking routine can do this without a generative model or an initial vector model. Fixed classifiers suit stable types such as questions and constraints, but do not by themselves resolve membership in continually changing projects. If real material reveals a meaningful gap in synonyms or implicit connections, then compare dictionaries, semantic indexes and small models by benefit and cost.
匹配到相同词语或共同引用，只能说明值得查看。旧经验是否适用，仍要保留原文条件；系: Matching terms or citations only establishes a reason to look. Preserve the original conditions when judging applicability. The system must not turn “related” into “proven to work.”
弹出与推荐，是两条独立的路径。: Opening and recommending are separate paths.
浮层先显示选区、提示词和已确认去处，不等待检索。索引随着工作记录变化增量更新；唤: The panel shows the selection, prompt and confirmed destination without waiting for retrieval. Update indexes incrementally as work records change, and query existing indexes on invocation. Input and basic handoff remain available during initial indexing and background updates.
晚到的结果只能补充入口，不能换目标、改写提示词、抢焦点或推走按钮。收起后，旧请求: Late results may add an entry point, but must not change the destination, rewrite the prompt, take focus or move the buttons. Dismissal invalidates the old request; reopening must not mix in results from a previous selection.
这些是需要在原生应用实现的要求，还不是速度测试结果。要分别测“按下快捷键到能打字: These are requirements for the native implementation, not benchmark results. Measure time from shortcut to editable input separately from time to candidates, covering cold starts, long idle periods, Chinese material, large indexes and different Macs. Avoiding models does not remove the need to test performance.
Apple 本地 AI：能用，但先不依赖。: Apple’s on-device AI: available to consider, not required.
Foundation Models 的端侧模型支持分类、摘要、提取实体和短文本判: The on-device Foundation Models model supports classification, summarization, entity extraction and short-text judgment. On-device inference can work offline without a cloud API key from the user. The APIs are available starting with macOS 26, but device, region, language, Apple Intelligence settings and model download status affect availability.
Apple 文档也提醒，端侧生成可能需要几秒；当前支持说明仍列有中国大陆相关限制: Apple also notes that on-device generation can take seconds, and its current support page still lists restrictions for mainland China. Newer framework versions support other model paths, so using Foundation Models does not automatically mean fully offline operation.
这说明它是可评估的技术，不说明 Beamhop 必须用它。第一版先验证不依赖模型: This makes it a technology to evaluate, not a requirement for Beamhop. Validate local recommendations without model dependencies first. Natural Language, Create ML and Core ML remain candidates for later use when they solve observed problems. The presence of system AI is not a reason to add a wait.
先让手上这一下成立。: Make this small action work first.
验收时不配置模型、不连接网络，仍要能输入、找已有去处并完成本地准备；外部工具不可: Acceptance should require no model configuration or network connection to type, find known destinations and prepare locally; retain material when the external tool is unavailable. Delayed recommendations must not interrupt an action in progress. B’s original record and conditions must remain inspectable.
这是新的产品方向预演。现有原生应用的工作名称仍主要绑定应用，精确会话寻址、自动关: This previews a new product direction. Work names in the current native app still primarily bind to applications. This page does not implement exact session addressing, automatic association or background analysis. Preparing content does not mean the receiver has sent, executed or completed it.
